title: Frappe ERPNext 12.7.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 stores imported Italian supplier e-invoices as public…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 12.7.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 improperly store imported Italian supplier e-invoices as public files accessible without authentication. This allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive supplier information such as names, VAT numbers, bank account details, and invoice line items by requesting predictable URLs based on supplier VAT numbers and invoice sequences.
